images.name: k2_SE
images.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create exactly one full-body portrait turnaround image using Image 1 as the APPROVED IDENTITY MASTER (S direction). Rotate the SAME young woman to SE: 45 degrees toward screen-right from the reference, facing the viewer's LOWER-RIGHT. Her front and anatomical left side are visible; her face and feet point toward lower-right. Her olive satchel on her anatomical LEFT hip is on SCREEN-RIGHT nearer the camera, and her upright staff in her anatomical RIGHT hand is on SCREEN-LEFT farther from the camera. No mirroring. Preserve the exact face, dark curly tied-back hair mass, sun-browned skin, early-20s age, body proportions, every costume item and its anatomical side, and even-weight standing rest pose with relaxed arms and right hand gripping the upright staff. Camera is fixed elevated three-quarter pinhole view, approximately 53 degrees above ground (projection C); character turns, camera does not. Preserve full-body centered portrait framing and standing image height like Image 1, feet fully visible. Flat uniform pure #00ff00 background over the whole canvas, no floor shadow, no checkerboard, no matting. Painted 2D illustration, high resolution, clean material planes, restrained surface texture, readable silhouette, no conspicuous brush grain. Same ivory linen shirt, plain navy sleeveless tabard with NO emblem, ONE chestnut diagonal harness strap over RIGHT shoulder carrying ONE olive canvas satchel at LEFT hip, ONE waist belt, chestnut laced bracers, navy trousers, chestnut buckled boots. PLAIN dark walnut staff with only small brass ferrules at foot and tip, NO ring or headpiece. All surfaces plain, no insignia, no extra objects. Single key light fixed at SCREEN UPPER-LEFT, does not rotate with character; screen-left key-facing surfaces lit, deep cool low-value ambient with readable shadows never pure black, slight rim on key-facing edge. No spell glow and no warm or saturated light source. Keep identity, outfit, proportions, pose and item geometry unchanged while turning the character.

references.role: APPROVED IDENTITY MASTER (direction S): identity, costume, proportions, pose and register

concerns: Rotation remains close to front-facing; face and feet do not clearly establish the requested 45-degree SE direction.
Camera appears substantially less elevated than the requested approximately 53 degrees.
Exact pose and costume geometry drift from the reference.
Delivered the task-specific 1024×1536 portrait rather than the register card's conflicting 512×512 registered frame and 2×2 sheet requirements.
Pure #00ff00 plate uniformity was not measured.
